headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest or slowing revenue.
summary: Coforge led with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. LTM, Tech Mahindra and HCLTech delivered double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑led deals. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% growth, the slowest among the majors. Overall sentiment is positive but guidance tightening signals caution.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys AI revenue up 29% YoY and Mphasis reporting 66% of new contracts AI‑led.

themes.title: Margin and guidance pressure
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; other companies kept or raised guidance but face margin compression.

themes.title: Strong top‑line growth outliers
themes.detail: Coforge and Persistent posted the highest YoY revenue growth, driven by large AI and engineering services wins.
